events.title: Lehi and His Family Leave Jerusalem
events.description: Lehi was called by God to warn the people of Jerusalem. The Lord then commanded him to leave the city with his family. They traveled through the wilderness, obtained the brass plates, built a ship, and crossed the sea to a promised land.
events.videoTitle: The Lord Commands Lehi's Family to Leave Jerusalem

events.title: Alma Teaches and Baptizes at the Waters of Mormon
events.description: Alma taught the people about repentance and faith in Jesus Christ. At the Waters of Mormon, those who accepted his teachings entered into a covenant with God and were baptized.

events.title: Ammon Teaches King Lamoni
events.description: Ammon served King Lamoni and protected the king's flocks. Through his service and testimony, Ammon taught Lamoni about God, repentance, and the plan of salvation. King Lamoni and many others were converted to the gospel of Jesus Christ.
events.videoTitle: Ammon Serves and Teaches King Lamoni

events.title: Captain Moroni Raises the Title of Liberty
events.description: When Amalickiah sought to destroy the liberty of the Nephites, Captain Moroni called the people to defend their families, faith, and freedom. He tore his coat and wrote the words of the Title of Liberty, calling the people to remember God and their covenant.
events.videoTitle: Captain Moroni Raises the Title of Liberty

events.title: Destruction and the Appearance of Jesus Christ
events.description: After great destruction covered the land, the survivors gathered near the temple in Bountiful. They heard the voice of the Father and witnessed Jesus Christ descend from heaven. The resurrected Savior introduced Himself as the Savior of the world and invited the people to come unto Him.
events.videoTitle: Jesus Christ Appears at the Temple

events.title: Moroni Preserves the Record
events.description: Moroni became the final keeper of the Nephite record after the destruction of his people. Knowing that the record would be preserved for a future generation, he completed the writings and buried the plates in the earth.
events.videoTitle: Moroni Invites All to Come unto Christ

events.title: Moroni Appears to Joseph Smith
events.description: Many centuries after Moroni buried the record, he appeared as an angel to the young Joseph Smith. Moroni told Joseph about the ancient record and the work that would be required to bring it forth. Joseph eventually received the plates and was prepared to translate them.
events.videoTitle: How We Got the Book of Mormon

events.title: The Book of Mormon Is Translated and Published
events.description: Joseph Smith translated the ancient record by the gift and power of God with the assistance of others. The translation was completed, and the Book of Mormon was published in 1830. The record was brought forth as another witness of Jesus Christ.
events.videoTitle: How We Got the Book of Mormon
